summaryFa: همان داستان قایق، با گونه‌های محو و پذیرشِ مشکل خود پیش از تعمیر.
storyFa: بنفش به پاروزدن سبز ایراد می‌گیرد. سپس با ناراحتی متوجه نشتی قایق خودش می‌شود و آن را ترمیم می‌کند. در پایان قایق خودش سالم است و با آرامش حرکت می‌کند.
meaningFa: خودنگری و اقدام برای اصلاح ضعف خود، سودی واقعی به زندگی خود فرد می‌رساند.

fullGenerationPromptEnglish:
Create ONE finished square 1:1 three-scene narrative watercolor illustration for an adult Persian book. The idea: it is easy to criticize another person's weakness, but recognizing and repairing our own problem gives a more useful reward. Show this through two people rowing wooden boats on a quiet lake.

LAYOUT
Two equal upper scenes read RIGHT first, LEFT second; one large wide lower scene is the outcome. Slim white paper gutters and irregular painterly edges, no rigid comic borders.

CAST AND SETTING
A PURPLE adult is the main character, with no eyelashes, plain purple body, small dark oval eyes and simple expression. A GREEN adult is the other rower, also a plain neutral medium adult. Fixed colors, identity and proportions in all scenes. No clothes or accessories.
The lake is bright blue-green with gentle painted ripples, a wooded shoreline, soft clouds and a sunny sky. A short wooden landing pier stands toward the left near the bank; reeds and a few pale rocks frame the lower-left painted edge. A simple small wooden footbridge is far away on the right in the lower scene. Background detail remains calm and subordinate.
Purple owns a tan plank-built wooden rowboat, identifiable by a GREEN BAND on the pointed bow. The same boat has the same small hull defect and later the same square wooden patch. Green rows a smaller ordinary tan wooden boat behind purple. Oars are simple coherent wooden shafts with broad blades.

UPPER RIGHT: CRITICISM OF THE OTHER ROWER
Purple sits naturally in the foreground boat, holding the wooden oars, and looks BACK AND ACROSS toward GREEN in the distant boat. Purple has a slightly critical frown and thought bubble with small thought-circle trail clearly belonging to purple. Exact thought:
"این چه پارو زدنیه؟!"
Green is struggling a little with the oar, anxious small expression and a few tiny blue effort/sweat marks, mild splashing beside the blade. Humor is gentle, not humiliating.
Crucial unnoticed problem: purple's OWN boat has a small visible hole/crack near the waterline and a little water accumulating inside beneath the seated legs. Make the defect visually readable without a large technical diagram. The green bow stripe is clear. Both entire boats and complete wooden oars fit inside the painted scene.

UPPER LEFT: RECOGNIZING THE OWN LEAK AND ACTING
Purple has stopped rowing and looks with genuine concern at the SAME hole in the OWN boat. Purple leans toward the hull and presses a small SQUARE WOODEN REPAIR PATCH with a few visible corner fasteners over that defect. The patch is in the same physical place as the leak, not floating or on a different boat. A wooden oar rests diagonally beside purple, fully contained, its blade near the water.
Purple's exact thought, with a trail clearly leading to purple:
"قایق خودم سوراخه!"
This moment is self-recognition and a concrete repair, not a new accusation at green. Same bow stripe, plank pattern, boat identity and scale consistent with a closer view. A modest wooden pier remains in the background.

LOWER WIDE: PERSONAL IMPROVEMENT
Purple now rows the SAME repaired wooden boat calmly and comfortably, with a warm relaxed smile. The small SQUARE PATCH is clearly visible on the hull at the repaired spot, and the boat interior is dry. Full boat and both complete oars are visible, with room around their blades. Purple's knees/legs sit naturally within the boat; the hull's normal occlusion does not mean missing legs.
Green rows more calmly in the distant right background, without continued ridicule or a competitive defeat. The visual payoff is purple's own safer easier rowing after dealing with the own problem, not beating the other person. No additional dialogue or text in this lower scene.

STYLE AND CHARACTER DESIGN
Use authentic moderate hand-painted layered watercolor on luminous textured white paper. Broad softly irregular overlapping translucent washes are visible inside heads, torsos, arms, hands and legs, as well as the scenery, with varied pigment density and subtle local pooling. Colors are warm and clear with restrained soft shading. Preserve a natural painterly finish, not flat/vector coloring, marker, uniform fine colored-pencil grain, glossy plastic/3D, repetitive embossed texture, heavy mottling or decorative splashes.
Every head is a PERFECT CIRCLE with equal width and height, an uninterrupted circular contour, no oval, chin, jaw, flattened lower arc, ears, hair or nose. Head joins shoulders directly WITHOUT A NECK. A soft darker crescent of the same local body hue beneath the head separates it from the upper torso without creating a neck segment.
All bodies have balanced medium adult proportions, neither plump/chibi nor spindly or excessively stretched. All genders use the same simple neutral structure: gently almost-parallel torso sides, natural unshaped pelvis, coherent limbs and naturally aligned legs. No breasts, tiny waist, waist notch, projected hips, separate buttock bulge or gendered contours. Fine short upper-outer eyelashes, where specified, are the principal female cue and must not change the eye design.
Eyes are modest small dark ovals with an optional TINY light glint INSIDE, never white sclera surrounding a pupil or large doll eyes. Simple eyebrows and small expressive mouths. No sharp flat pink circular cheek spots; blush is absent or only barely perceptible diffuse translucent watercolor.
Each openly visible hand has exactly THREE FINGERS PLUS ONE THUMB, with natural gripping or folded-finger occlusion allowed. Body contours use darker versions of the SAME LOCAL BODY COLOR, not black; facial details and Persian letters may be dark.
Full figures, feet and important objects stay within scene boundaries; natural furniture/boat/prop occlusion is allowed but no body part or object is cut by file or panel edges. Clear irregular watercolor boundaries, generous CLEAN WHITE PAPER outer margins, narrow white gutters, no heavy panel borders. Polished thoughtful adult-book art, warm, kind, quietly witty and family friendly.
All in-image writing is ONLY the short verbatim Persian text specified for that scene, with accurate connected letters and right-to-left direction. No English, extra captions, numbers, watermark or signature. The pictured actions communicate the idea without an explanatory moral caption.
